mapper.select: SELECT word_id, category_id, keyword, match_type, risk_level, is_active, created_by, create_time, updated_by, update_time FROM sensitive_words WHERE is_active = TRUE AND ( -- 精确匹配（match_type = 0） (match_type = 0 AND #{text} = keyword) OR -- 模糊匹配（match_type = 1） (match_type = 1 AND #{text} ILIKE CONCAT('%', keyword, '%')) ) ORDER BY risk_level DESC, LENGTH(keyword) DESC
